description: New York CDL delta. Air brakes, cargo, and hours stay in core_cdl.json.

questions.q: The minimum age to drive a commercial vehicle from New York into another state is
questions.explanation: Interstate commerce requires the driver to be at least 21. That federal age applies to a driver leaving this state.

questions.q: You live in New York and drive a CMV. Who issues the CDL?
options: The state that titled the truck
The state where the load started
questions.explanation: A CDL is issued by your state of domicile, the state where you live.

questions.q: In New York, a driver of a bus such as a school bus must meet, in addition to the CDL,
options: The bus driver requirements of VTL Article 19-A
A yearly vision test and nothing more after that
A separate taxi and limousine license from the city
No additional rules beyond holding the right CDL
questions.explanation: Article 19-A of the Vehicle and Traffic Law adds bus-driver qualifications, such as driving-record reviews and periodic road and medical checks, run through the employing carrier.

questions.q: A New York CDL holder who is 18, 19 or 20 may drive a commercial vehicle
questions.explanation: New York issues CDLs from 18, but federal rules require 21 for interstate commerce, so a younger driver stays within the state.
